lines.t: Beloved, tell me what you know,
On what foundation does love grow?
What thread is woven through My Word,
Whose voice within your soul is heard?
Can mortal eyes behold the flame,
Or know the heart from which it came?
Chorus:
I am He — the Life, the Light,
I break the dark, I heal the night.
Come, all who thirst, come unto Me,
Drink deep of grace and rise, set free.
Verse 2:
I breathed My life, I gave you frame,
You bear the image of My name.
My blood was shed, My love poured down,
A crown of thorns became your crown.
Awake, My child, the grave shall flee,
For all who love shall live in Me.
Chorus:
I am He — the Life, the Light,
I break the dark, I heal the night.
Come, all who thirst, come unto Me,
Drink deep of grace and rise, set free.
Bridge:
You are the reason stars were hung,
The center of creation’s song.
You’ll see My face, you’ll understand,
When heaven walks with earth again.
So keep your heart, My chosen ones,
Fix your eyes upon the Son.
The trumpet sounds, the day’s begun —
Behold, the Lord has come!
Yes, behold… the Lord has come
